title: HSK1 Gate 8 · Three Kingdoms
explanationEn: Gate 8: Three Kingdoms. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第8关：三国。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国，叫三国。三个国常常打仗。那时候有一个很聪明的人，叫诸葛亮。刘备请了他三次，他才出来帮刘备。
passageEn: After the Han, China split into three states, called the Three Kingdoms. The three states were always at war. At that time there was a very clever man called Zhuge Liang. Liu Bei asked him three times before he came out to help.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: After the Han, China split into three states, called the Three Kingdoms.
comprehension.answer: 汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国，叫三国。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: At that time there was a very clever man called Zhuge Liang.
comprehension.answer: 那时候有一个很聪明的人，叫诸葛亮。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 中国 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“中国”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 中国 (Zhōngguó) means "China" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “中国”（Zhōngguó）的意思是“China”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 三 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“三”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 三 (sān) means "three" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “三”（sān）的意思是“three”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国，叫三国。

options.text: The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
After the Han, China split into three states, called the Three Kingdoms.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.

check.explanationEn: "汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国，叫三国。" means "After the Han, China split into three states, called the Three Kingdoms.".
check.explanation: “汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国，叫三国。”的意思是“After the Han, China split into three states, called the Three Kingdoms.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Three Kingdoms in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说三国。
